Name: Kitty Scarecrow Replacement (XNB Mod Update for 1.11)
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
This is a 1.11 compatibility update for Jinxiewinxie's mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/191/?]Kitty Scarecrow Raplacement[/url]. All creds go to them.

[i]*****This will not work with any other mods that change the Craftables.xnb file*****[/i]

Now you can enjoy this mod AND still recolor your chests! :3

EDIT: I accidentally forgot to copy over one of scarecrows so I fixed it and re-uploaded. To the one person that has already downloaded this, you need to re-download, sorry!

Enjoy!
-Ariella

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->TileSheets folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Craftables.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.

[/list]

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
